description.value: L&C French Bakery is a Parisian-style bakery founded by two women — Chef Cyrielle, who trained in Paris and worked at Michelin-starred restaurants, and Lisa, a former Fairmont and Wickaninnish Inn hospitality manager. The Baker Street location serves as the bakery's commissary kitchen and a takeout-only counter, offering fresh croissants, artisan pastries, sandwiches, coffee, and macarons made daily from scratch. It sits right on Nelson's main commercial strip, making it a natural and quick refuelling stop for cyclists passing through town.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 8m; stands (2 spaces) at 22m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the Baker Street location at 390 Baker St, Nelson matches the OSM record; it is explicitly described as a takeout-only commissary kitchen, consistent with OSM's outdoor_seating=no tag. The website provides a phone number for this location ((778) 962-0020) that is absent from OSM. The online ordering page lists a 'Gluten free and / or vegan selection' menu category, confirming GF/vegan options, but no mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill is found anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists (778) 962-0020 for the Baker Street location — added from website.

Business has two locations (Baker Street and Fairview/711 Radio Ave); the OSM record covers only the Baker Street takeout/commissary location. A separate OSM node may exist or be warranted for the Fairview dine-in location.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible bakery and café on Nelson's main street. Confirmed open with an online ordering system and current hours.
enrichment_extras.notes: Baker Street location is takeout-only and functions as the commissary kitchen. The Fairview location (711 Radio Ave) offers dine-in, a patio, and a different phone number (250-551-3999).
